name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.iterate_length_le
typeText:
∀ {n : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Sized n g →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      LE.le.{0} j
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
            (List.length.{0}
              (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs
                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkL g
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)))))
            1) →
        LE.le.{0}
          (List.length.{0}
            (Nat.iterate.{1}
                (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.ffStep
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkL g
                    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
                j (Prod.mk.{0, 0} Bool.false List.nil.{0})).2)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.flowBound n)

source.code:
theorem iterate_length_le {n : ℕ} {g : GInstance} (hn : Sized n g) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ (g.networkL g.base.canonIds).arcs.length + 1) :
    ((ffStep (g.networkL g.base.canonIds))^[j] (false, [])).2.length ≤ flowBound n := by
  have := ffStep_iterate_length (g.networkL g.base.canonIds) j
  have hNL := netNodes_length_le hn
  have hA := arcs_length_le hn
  have : j * (g.networkL g.base.canonIds).nodes.length ≤ (arcBound n + 1) * (2 * n + 3) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  unfold flowBound; omega
